pretreatments.description: Cutting municipal waste into particulates and grinding into small fine particles (lower than 4 mm) by a home type coffee grinder
Diluting cow manure and grinded kitchen waste with tap water until their concentrations reached near the municipal waste concentration
Co-digestion with different NaOH and H_2O_2 amounts in airtight glass reactors (250 mL) under mesophilic conditions (35 ± 1 °C) for 40 days
Treatment with different amounts of NaOH and H_2O_2
